title: Run! These Rich-Looking Nordstrom Dresses Should Cost Hundreds, but They're up to 81% Off
text:
Nordstrom's End of Season Sale means luxe-looking spring dresses from Vince Camuto, Treasure & Bond and more up to 81% off — details!
Nordstrom is a one-stop shop for all things luxe. But if you're like Us and want the expensive look without the corresponding price tag, it's your lucky day! Nordstrom's End of Season Sale is running, which means mega deals on classy dresses — we're talking up to 81% off.
Whether you're searching for a chic new dress for errands, weddings, in-office days or anything in between, you'll find it on major sale. The best deals from Sam Edelman, Petal & Pup and more are flying off the shelves, so if you see something you want, snag it ASAP. See our rich-looking favorites below!
15 Best Deals During Nordstrom's End of Season Sale — Up to 81% Off
